newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer in steady market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer in steady market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka edged up marginally to close at 42.5490/5495 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday against Monday's close at 42.5495/5500.
The local unit quoted stronger at 42.5460/5495 in early trading but eased slightly as demand for dollar picked up later in the session, dealers said.
"It was more or less a steady session. There was balance in demand and supply," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates finished at 4.5 percent to 5.5 percent, unchanged from Monday.
